input_constraint: every input is the selected generator's mixed_sizes_1_to_6 profile; sizes 3 and 4 visibly distinguish thresholds 3, 4, and 5
parameter_selection: one seed-modulo-three selection before any pair unless explicitly overridden
racket_source: (rule! (lambda (g) (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))) (let* ((bg 7) (objs (objects g bg))) (reduce (lambda (acc obj) (let* ((drop (if (>= (obj-size obj) 3) (- (- h 1) (obj-r2 obj)) 0)) (cells (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) drop) (second p))) (obj-cells obj)))) (paint-cells acc cells (obj-color obj)))) (empty-grid h w bg) objs)))))
